hooks.command: rvf_hook_target_script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stop.py"; if [ -f "$rvf_hook_target_script" ]; then python3 "$rvf_hook_target_script"; rvf_hook_target_script_exit_status=$?; if [ "$rvf_hook_target_script_exit_status" -eq 2 ]; then rvf_hook_target_script_exit_status=0; fi; exit "$rvf_hook_target_script_exit_status"; else { rvf_hook_breadcrumb_directory="$RVF_USER_LOCAL_DATA_ROOT"; [ -n "$rvf_hook_breadcrumb_directory" ] || rvf_hook_breadcrumb_directory="$HOME/.rvf/user-local-data"; mkdir -p "$rvf_hook_breadcrumb_directory" && printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" 'Stop' "$rvf_hook_target_script" >>"$rvf_hook_breadcrumb_directory/rvf-hook-target-missing.log"; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; fi
